3d_anime.label: 3D 动漫（立体/电影感）
3d_anime.prompt_prefix: A cinematic 3D anime cel-shaded render (three-dimensional stylized anime, like a high-end 3D animated film), with strong depth, volumetric lighting, realistic shadows, depth of field and layered foreground/background.

2d_anime.label: 2D 动漫（手绘/国风）
2d_anime.prompt_prefix: A 2D anime cel-shaded illustration (hand-drawn anime style), clean line art, flat color layers with painted backgrounds.

note: 模板可按需切换风格；2D 国风/历史类保留 2D，综艺/舞台/生活类默认 3D 动漫；contract/style_map.json 可覆盖。
